ops.text: PoC on macOS 26.5.2 with a real Developer ID Application cert (SXKCTF23Q2) + full Apple CA chain (rcodesign 0.29.0). Controlled 3-way trial, only the CD teamID value varying: (A) auto team -> runs, category 6, csops teamID=SXKCTF23Q2; (B) explicit --team-name SXKCTF23Q2 (correct value) -> runs, category 6; (C) explicit --team-name FORGE00000 (forged, same cert/chain/timestamp/flag) -> CD declares FORGE00000, codesign --verify = 'a Team Identifier is wrong or inappropriate', exec = SIGKILL rc=137, never runs. B-vs-C isolates the team string as the sole cause.
